_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: Kitchen and customer display. Sign in with the venue's Vesopa account (The Vesopa Kitchen for testers), choose Vesopa Kitchen. 1) Every ticket is the same size; a ticket with more than fits says More: tap it to see the whole ticket, cross items off, Rush, Print. 2) Settings (manager PIN): name this kitchen, choose the sites it cooks for, add a kitchen, set a kitchen printer and Print each new ticket. 3) Settings > Network and hardware: tickets from the tills over Wi-Fi and from the back office. On another device choose Customer display, connect it from the till's Settings > Customer displays, and open its Network and hardware the same way. Then ring up orders on a till in one site and check only that site's kitchens show them.
release_notes: Vesopa Go 1.2.32: kitchen tickets all the same size, with tap to see the whole ticket; name each kitchen and choose the venue sites it cooks for, from the device, the till or the back office; a kitchen printer; and a Network and hardware page for kitchen and customer display devices.
